general.title: General
general.description: Choose the app language, appearance, and startup behavior

taskbar.title: Taskbar
taskbar.description: Customize the taskbar player's layout, appearance, and content

data.title: Data
data.description: Manage cached lyrics, app settings, and runtime logs

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Check the status of the taskbar, media sessions, lyrics, and audio features

about.title: About
about.description: View version, update, and open-source project information

language.title: Display language
language.description: Lyrics follow Simplified/Traditional Chinese changes when set to follow the interface

reducedMotion.title: Reduce motion
reducedMotion.description: Reduce lyric, artwork, and interface animations; when off, follow the Windows motion setting

disableGpuAcceleration.title: Disable GPU acceleration
disableGpuAcceleration.description: Disable GPU acceleration to reduce memory use; CPU load may increase and animations may be less smooth. Takes effect after restarting.
disableGpuAcceleration.restartRequired: This change takes effect after restarting the app

placement.title: Component placement
placement.description: Auto places the player on the left when taskbar icons are centered, otherwise on the right

horizontalOffset.title: Horizontal offset
horizontalOffset.description: Positive moves right; negative moves left. Logical pixels scale with the system DPI.

overlap.title: Overlap priority
overlap.description: When space is limited, let MuseTune overlap taskbar items or clip it to avoid them

transparency.title: Background transparency
transparency.description: Only affects the theme background, not text or controls
transparency.coverDisabled: Blurred artwork uses its own effect; switch to the theme background to adjust transparency

backgroundStyle.title: Background style
backgroundStyle.description: Use the theme background or blurred artwork as the component background
backgroundStyle.progressFallback: Blurred artwork and full-height progress cannot be used together. Continuing will switch progress to the bottom bar.
backgroundStyle.backgroundFallback: Full-height progress and blurred artwork cannot be used together. Continuing will switch to the theme background.

width.title: Component width
width.description: Auto fills available taskbar space, with a minimum width of 200px
width.autoHint: Fills the available taskbar space with a minimum width of 200px

display.title: Target display
display.description: Choose which displays show the taskbar player

controls.title: Playback controls
controls.visibleDescription: Show or hide the entire group of playback controls
controls.buttonsDescription: Select buttons to show and drag to reorder
controls.volumeTargetDescription: Hover over the taskbar player and scroll the mouse wheel to adjust it
controls.volumeRestoreDescription: After switching to system master volume, the taskbar will no longer adjust the current player's individual volume. Restore it to 100% and unmute it first?
controls.volumeRestoreFailed: Could not restore the current player volume

cover.title: Artwork
cover.rotateDescription: Rotates during playback and stays in place when paused
cover.sourceDescription: Show the current player's icon in the lower-right corner of the artwork
cover.shapeDescription: Playback rotation is only available for circular covers

elementOrder.title: Element order
elementOrder.description: Drag to reorder; normal and lyrics modes are saved separately

progress.title: Playback progress
progress.positionDescription: Top and bottom positions are supported only for the bar style

spectrum.title: Audio spectrum
spectrum.visibleDescription: Turning this off stops audio capture and spectrum processing
spectrum.widthDescription: It overlays content in normal mode and occupies its own space in lyrics mode
spectrum.verticalDescription: Centered bars expand both ways; bottom-aligned bars grow upward
spectrum.sensitivityDescription: Adjust how strongly the spectrum responds to the input level
spectrum.smoothingDescription: Higher values produce steadier motion but react more slowly
spectrum.frameRateDescription: Lower frame rates reduce spectrum updates, communication and rendering work

trackInfo.title: Track information
trackInfo.visibleDescription: When off, hide the title and artist and free the space for other elements
trackInfo.scrollDescription: Scrolls overflowing titles; disabling this or enabling reduced motion shows an ellipsis

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.enabledDescription: When off, restore track information and playback controls
lyrics.linesDescription: Two-line mode lets you choose the second line’s content
lyrics.secondaryDescription: Translation first automatically shows the next line when no translation is available
lyrics.chineseVariantDescription: Convert the song title, artist, and lyrics between Simplified and Traditional Chinese; Follow interface preserves source text when the interface is in English
lyrics.wordHighlightDescription: Available only for lyrics that include word-level timing
lyrics.sizeDescription: Choose 10–18px; two-line mode automatically uses tighter spacing
lyrics.playedColorDescription: Text already reached in word-timed lyrics
lyrics.unplayedColorDescription: Used for upcoming text and the second lyric line
lyrics.fontDescription: Use an installed Windows font; opening the list discovers newly installed fonts
lyrics.preRollOn: On: finishes the transition just before the lyric timestamp for tighter timing; during continuous vocals, the previous line may leave early.
lyrics.preRollOff: Off: starts the transition at the lyric timestamp, in sync with the vocals.
lyrics.offsetDescription: Positive delays lyrics; negative advances them. Does not affect animation pre-roll.
lyrics.networkDescription: Allow online lookup, or use only local lyrics and the existing cache
lyrics.parallelDescription: Queries multiple sources at once. This is usually faster but makes more network requests. The current player's service always takes part and moves to the front when it is not selected.
lyrics.onlineSourcesDescription: Choose which online sources may be queried and drag to set their priority; disabled sources receive no requests, except the current player's service

mediaSession.title: Player selection
mediaSession.description: Choose which player MuseTune displays when multiple media sessions are available
mediaSession.strategyDescription: Most recently played switches only when a player starts playback; simply opening an app does not take over
mediaSession.supportedOnlyDescription: Use media sessions only from QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Soda Music, Kugou Music, and Spotify
mediaSession.priorityDescription: When multiple players are playing, choose the first one in this list

theme.title: Component accent color
theme.description: Set the accent color for the taskbar player
theme.presetsDescription: Choose a preset color and apply it immediately
theme.customDescription: Enter a hexadecimal color in #RRGGBB format
theme.invalidColor: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color, for example #1677ff

cache.title: Lyrics cache
cache.clearConfirmDescription: All cached lyrics will be deleted and retrieved again as needed during playback.
cache.currentClearedDescription: The current song's lyrics were removed from the MuseTune cache
cache.refreshStartedDescription: MuseTune will run the complete retrieval process again using the current network settings

config.title: App settings
config.resetConfirmDescription: All settings will return to their defaults and MuseTune will restart. This cannot be undone.

logs.title: Runtime logs
logs.clearConfirmDescription: Archived log files will be deleted. The active log will remain and continue recording without restarting the app.
logs.fileDescription: Includes the active log and archived files

update.title: Version & updates
update.portableDescription: The portable build does not run an installer. Download the new archive, exit MuseTune, and replace the existing executable. The data folder keeps your settings, cache, and logs.
update.installConfirmDescription: After the download finishes, MuseTune will close and install the update. Continue?
update.notificationBody: Version {version} is available. Open Settings → About to download and install it.
update.notificationPortableBody: Version {version} is available. Open Settings → About to download the new portable archive and replace it manually.

project.openFailed: Could not open the link in your default browser

feedback.title: Community & feedback
feedback.description: Found a problem or have an idea? Choose how to get in touch.
feedback.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please copy the group number manually.

diagnostics.copyFailed: Could not copy the diagnostic report

taskbar.description: Windows taskbar detection and MuseTune Bar window status

lyrics.description: Original lyric source and how lyrics were retrieved for this playback
